purpose: Canonical bounded application context linking one authenticated Account to its DANTE self Person and user/default timezone policy without collapsing Account, Person, Principal or Actor.

columns.name: account_ref
columns.meaning: Authenticated Access/Auth Account owning this application-context row.
columns.value_contract: Existing DANTE Account reference; Account remains distinct from Person.

columns.name: self_person_ref
columns.meaning: DANTE self Person used by product operations for this Account context.
columns.value_contract: Existing Person NativeRef; initial creation is authorized only by the bounded ensure_account_application_context capability.

columns.name: timezone_mode
columns.meaning: User/default timezone selection policy for application operations and display defaults.
columns.value_contract: follow_device|fixed; this never replaces object-owned temporal semantics.

columns.name: fixed_zone_id
columns.meaning: Named IANA timezone used only when timezone_mode=fixed.
columns.value_contract: Runtime-available named IANA timezone, trimmed and at most 255 characters; numeric UTC offsets are rejected.

primary_key.name: pk_account_application_context
primary_key.reason: At most one current application-context policy row exists per Account.

foreign_keys.name: fk_account_application_context_account_ref_account
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: The application context belongs to one existing Access/Auth Account without redefining Account as a Domain identity.

foreign_keys.name: fk_account_application_context_self_person_ref_person
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: The self reference targets the concrete Person native owner; no universal Account-to-Person cardinality is inferred beyond this row.

check_constraints.name: ck_account_application_context_timezone_mode
check_constraints.reason: Keep user/default timezone policy in the two accepted PV-01 modes.

check_constraints.name: ck_account_application_context_timezone_policy
check_constraints.expression_contract: follow_device requires fixed_zone_id NULL; fixed requires a trimmed non-empty <=255 named-zone candidate that is not a numeric UTC offset
check_constraints.reason: Reject structurally inconsistent or fixed-offset timezone policy before the named-zone trigger check.

indexes.name: pk_account_application_context
indexes.reason: Primary-key lookup by authenticated Account and one-row-per-Account enforcement.

triggers.name: trg_account_application_context_timezone
triggers.reason: A fixed user/default timezone must exist in the PostgreSQL runtime timezone catalog; follow-device stores no fixed zone.

state_history.current_binding: One current application-context row is selected directly by Account primary key; this is not Domain MaterialState.
state_history.immutability_policy: Account and self Person linkage are not generic runtime mutation surfaces; timezone preference mutation requires a future bounded application operation.

lifecycle.retention: Retained with the Account application context while product data can depend on its self Person linkage.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No direct runtime DELETE; lifecycle changes require a future bounded semantic operation.

obligations: Person != Account != Principal != Actor remains enforced by concrete foreign-key topology rather than identifier reuse
runtime has no generic INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE authority on the context table
fixed timezone policy accepts named IANA zones and rejects offsets/unknown zones
concurrent first-use creates at most one self Person and one application context per Account
